description: Find open government tenders (calls for bids) by what is being bought and, optionally, the country. Returns up to 10 live tenders from official procurement portals (refreshed daily) with buyer, deadline, value and an askTender link. Use when the user asks to find tenders, calls for bids or public contracts to bid on.

closing_within_days.description: Only tenders whose deadline is within this many days.

country.description: Country whose tenders to search: a name or ISO code, e.g. 'United Kingdom', 'IN', 'Germany'. Leave empty for all countries.

query.description: What the company sells or the work wanted, e.g. 'school cleaning services', 'LED street lights', 'cloud migration'.

name: search_tenders
title: Search open tenders
